To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Ce species were assembled into the mesoporous silica channels and Pd clusters were supported on the surface of the mesoporous Ce-containing silica.
the ordered hexagonal mesopores of the Pd supported catalyst can be maintained after Pd and Ce were introduced by the post-impregnation method.
Ce and Pd can be incorporated into the walls of HMS structure and the Ce and Pd surface chemical state can be well controlled by the post-impregnation methods.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of a new type of mesoporous catalysts with ordered hexagonal mesopores,which is expected to be a potential catalyst for the hydrogenation reactions.
the synthesis and characterization of Ce and Pd co-doped hexagonal mesoprous silica materials, and the results provide a new way to synthesize Pd catalysts.
the synthesis of Pd/Cesilica catalysts and the investigation on their structure and surface chemical state.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Pd/Ce containing HMS material prepared by the post- assembly and impregnation method is a new type of catalyst with high dispersion and good reducibility of Pd species.

PdO2 species were incorporated into the walls of Ce-containing hexagonal mesostructured silica and CeO2 species were deposited on the surface of Ce-containing hexa-gonal mesostructured silica by the post-impregnation method, and PdO2 were dispersed on the surface of hexagonal meso-structured silica by the assembly method.
the Pd/Ce containing HMS materials were successfully prepared by post-assembly and Pd/Ce were incorporated into the walls of HMS structure.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Ce-containing hexagonal mesostructured silica materials with ordered structure,high surface area and high thermal stability were synthesized,and Pd was highly dispersed in the mesopore channels of the silica matrix.
Pd/Ce-HMS catalyst was prepared by the impregnation of Pd(NO3)2 with Pd2+ species incorporated into the framework or into the walls of Ce-containing hexagonal mesostructured silica.

the Ce species can be incorporated into the walls of HMS structure and the Pd species are well dispersed in the channels of HMS structure by using the post-assembly method,which is a good method to prepare Pd/Ce-HMS catalysts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Pd/Ce-HMS materials can be used to prepare new type of Pd catalysts with good dispersion and high metal surface area.
the Ce-containing mesoporous silicates are promising supports for the preparation of highly active catalysts.
Ce and Pd surface chemical state can be controlled by adjusting the reaction condition.
